design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 (billing_and_nonpayment_cancellation)

[0] Draw. draw_counts.py --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[5, 6, 4, 5]. Assignment: assisted payment (root) 5, late fee charge 5, renewal down payment 6, additional-premium bill 4. Multiset {5,6,4,5} matches.

[1] Why this is a good test. The customer says one thing: "pay off everything on my billing account today, with my debit card while I have you on the phone". The scored root value (847.37) is the balance after three charges that are owed today but not yet on the account, plus a representative fee with five tiers. Nothing in the request names those charges; the agent finds them only by reading the assisted-payment rule (three prerequisite sentences), then reading the ledger and policy history and seeing that each awaited state is false. Difficulty is reading policy + reconciling history + multi-factor arithmetic, never tool choice: each problem has exactly one target tool.

[2] Scope. Prior tasks: none. Claimed: billing_ext_late_fee_charge, billing_ext_additional_premium_bill, billing_ext_renewal_down_payment, billing_ext_assisted_payment; tools charge_late_fee_8c3b3141, bill_additional_premium_a7869908, bill_renewal_down_payment_49af2eee, pay_balance_by_phone_6aa6e134 (owner=user). Headroom left for task 1 (draw: 1 prerequisite, factors [5,4]): return-premium credit, installment invoice of a non-renewal term, refunds/write-offs, courtesy waiver, and a different customer-owned payment. None of those subjects is touched here.
Pre-check constraints: billing_notice_of_cancellation, billing_rescind, billing_reinstate, billing_cancel_nonpay and billing_notice_issue all trigger auto writes, so no task tool may write them; any policy with subject billing_fee_charged inherits the grace_elapsed gate, so the only fee policy claimed is the late fee itself.

[3] Problem-tree card.
Root: billing_ext_assisted_payment (target pay_balance_by_phone_6aa6e134, owner user, on_request).
Edges (all from the root, all kind value_input, gate binding as_balance, form state):
 E1 -> billing_ext_late_fee_charge. Sentence (affirmative): "The assisted payment amount is fixed only after the account carries the late fee owed on every installment of the current term that stayed unpaid past its grace days." Opening falsity: installment 6 (ledger 5013907a-08ea-4e1f-9a34-423d02ae6991, due 2026-09-26, 151.37 + 4.34) has only 90.00 paid (cbf9e5f9-..., 2026-09-24); grace days Sep 27-29 ended; the only late fee of the term is on installment 3 (6f3f7280-..., 2026-06-30). Resolved by charge_late_fee_8c3b3141 (agent). Exactly one write of this difficulty posts a late fee entry: the late fee policy.
 E2 -> billing_ext_additional_premium_bill. Sentence ("before ... must"): "Before the assisted payment amount is fixed, every additional premium received after the last installment of its term was invoiced must stand on the account as an additional-premium bill." Opening falsity: additional-premium receipt a524843f-... (94.59, posted 2026-09-29, source e73edcdb-...) and installment 6 invoiced 2026-09-06 (last of 6); no billing_endorsement_charge carries that source. Resolved by bill_additional_premium_a7869908; only that policy writes an additional-premium bill.
 E3 -> billing_ext_renewal_down_payment. Sentence (negated): "The assisted payment amount is not worked out until the account carries the renewal down payment invoice for a renewal term whose renewal bill date has arrived." Opening falsity: renewal term premium c6edfa21-... (term 2026-10-20, received 2026-09-29); expiration 2026-10-20 - renewal_bill_lead_days 20 = 2026-09-30 = today; no installment of term 2026-10-20 on the ledger. Resolved by bill_renewal_down_payment_49af2eee; only that policy writes installment 1 of a renewal term.
Four-point test on each sentence: ordering connective (only after / before...must / not until) joining the root's own result to a record state; state named in ledger words (late fee, additional-premium bill, renewal down payment invoice); no tool, id or code token; scope "every installment ... unpaid past its grace days", "every additional premium received after the last installment", "a renewal term whose bill date has arrived" equals each edge's condition. Directions mixed (affirmative, before-must, negated). Derivation: sentence + ledger (state false) + the depended-on rule ("A late fee charge is booked once on an installment ...", "An additional premium received after the last installment of its term was invoiced is billed at once ...", "The renewal down payment is installment 1 of the renewal term, invoiced on the renewal bill date ...") -> exactly one resolving write each.
Topological order: late fee, additional-premium bill, renewal down payment, assisted payment (the three prerequisites commute; see order_uniqueness: all 6 orders give 3.80 / 96.38 / 649.39 / 847.37 and the same terminal DB).
Deletion sensitivity (actual run): skip late fee -> 843.57; skip additional-premium bill -> 750.88; skip renewal invoice -> 178.41 (balance 175.89, purpose rate 0.75). Gold 847.37.
Customer-owned write: the assisted payment (she authorizes her own debit card); handed over by the agent last, after the three postings.
No user hint: the persona never names a late fee, a bill for the added driver or a renewal invoice; the daughter's addition and the 90.00 partial payment are answers given only when asked.
Tools validate nothing: every tool writes its entry with the arguments given (task_tools.py bodies have no conditions except writing the fee row only when the fee is above 0.00).

[4] Base-invariant card.
 Step 8 late fee (subject billing_fee_charged): billing_evt_late_fee.grace_elapsed (time): anchor billing_ledger.due_date of installment 6 = 2026-09-26, duration variants.late_fee_grace_days = 3 (Direct Bill), counting starts the day after the due date, boundary exclusive, relation not_before -> grace days 09-27, 09-28, 09-29; first chargeable day 09-30 = frozen date (just before: 09-29 no fee; at boundary: 09-30 fee). Base also: no late fee on notice_pending/cancelled accounts (account status current), cap late_fee_max_per_term 3 (one fee so far this term), underpayment tolerance 2.00 (65.71 unpaid). Other governing policies (installment schedule, returned payment, reinstatement, payment application) have no gate on this subject.
 Step 10 additional-premium bill (billing_endorsement_charge): installment schedule only, no gate; spread method with no installment left -> billed at once due ap_immediate_due_days (20) -> 2026-10-20.
 Step 12 renewal invoice (billing_installment_billed): installment schedule only; bill date = expiration - renewal_bill_lead_days.
 Step 14 payment (billing_payment_received): cross-account payments (posted to the one account named), reinstatement (account current, so the no-fee-on-cure/reinstatement clause does not apply), payment application (debit card accepted by the plan, no certified-funds restriction: certified_funds_until empty). No time gate.

[5] Business-object card. One billing account ffb120de-722a-49f0-bf0c-c32a847f3b79 (policy CAP-VA-5530418, a2faa706-...). Late fee object: installment 6 of term 2026-04-20 (correlation key installment_number 6 + term); payments in the one-month window: only the 90.00 of 2026-09-24 (the 155.73 of 2026-08-25 settles installment 5 and is exactly one whole month back, excluded). Additional-premium object: auto transaction e73edcdb-... (source of receipt a524843f-...); the endorsement fee 10.00 (ad05271a-..., source a3e945aa-... = the driver-add endorsement) is a separate settled charge on the balance. Renewal object: term 2026-10-20 (receipt c6edfa21-..., 2148.70, written 2026-09-29 after the driver addition; the original offer of 2026-09-20 quoted 1358.96 without Isabel). Expiring full-term premium as last rated: 1812.60, the full-term premium after the 2026-09-24 driver-add change (auto_additional_premium e73edcdb-..., full_term_premium_after); the term premium entry 1a371563-... (1146.80) is the figure only when the term had no premium-bearing change.

[6] Factor card (tier taken / evidence / baseline figure from the sensitivity run).
 Late fee (expected 3.80, whole baseline 15.00):
  state amount (param, cross auto): VA -> 12.00; baseline 15.00 -> 4.75.
  charged share (method): 90.00 paid in window, unpaid 65.71 of 155.71 -> 5.06404; baseline whole 12.00 -> 9.00. Near-miss: 2026-08-25 payment one whole month back.
  loyalty rate (param, multi-source notices-12m AND tenure, cross auto): no notice in 12 months (2025-08-05 notice is 13 months back) and 113 months since 2017-04-20 -> 0.50; baseline -> 7.60. Near-miss: the 2025-08-05 notice is one month outside the window.
  returned-payment rate (param): one return (f970e100-..., 2026-01-27) -> 1.25; baseline -> 3.04.
  repeat-lateness rate (param): one late fee already this term (installment 3) -> 1.20; baseline -> 3.17. Near-miss: the 2025-07-30 late fee belongs to term 2025-04-20.
 Additional-premium bill (expected 96.38, whole baseline 102.59 = 94.59 + installment fee 8.00):
  state charge (param, cross auto): VA -> 4.00; baseline 8.00 -> 99.38.
  charge method (method): 94.59 >= 75 -> 4.00 + 2% x 19.59; baseline flat -> 96.09.
  relief rate (param, multi-source last-method AND no-returns): debit card yes, returns no -> 0.75; baseline -> 97.48. Near-miss: the returned January payment was bank EFT but is not the most recent payment.
  endorsement offset (param): 10.00 endorsement fee on 2026-09-29 -> 1.50; baseline -> 97.88.
 Renewal down payment (expected 649.39, whole baseline 429.74 = 20% x 2148.70):
  record percentage (param, multi-source returns AND late fees): return 2026-01-27 and late fees 2026-06-30 (+ today's) -> 30%; baseline 20% -> 451.32. Near-miss: 2025-07-30 late fee 14 months back.
  tenure reduction (param, cross auto): 113 months -> 5 points; baseline -> 748.42.
  notice surcharge (param): notice 2025-08-05 is 13 months back (12-24 band) -> 5 points; baseline -> 550.36.
  method reduction (param): last payment debit card -> 1 point; baseline -> 669.19.
  increase base (method, cross auto): 2148.70 / 1812.60 = 118.5% -> 1812.60 + 0.5 x 336.10 = 1980.65; baseline renewal premium -> 698.12. Near-miss: the term premium entry 1146.80 is not the expiring figure once the term carries a premium-bearing change.
  new-driver deposit (param, cross auto history): auto_driver_add a3e945aa-... effective 2026-09-24 -> 75.00; baseline -> 574.39.
 Assisted payment (expected 847.37, whole baseline 716.12 = 845.28 + 5.00):
  state fee (param, cross auto) VA 3.50 -> baseline 713.77; fee method (method) balance 845.28 >= 500 -> 3.50 + 0.25% x 345.28, baseline 712.80; loyalty (param, multi-source, cross auto) tenure yes, returns no -> 0.80, baseline 713.54; purpose (param) renewal invoice posted today -> 0.50, baseline 714.99; frequency (param) two assisted payments (b25a7e7c-... 2025-11-25, 1bf6ce5d-... 2026-05-25) -> 1.20, baseline 712.73.
 Overrides declared (each names the base sentence it replaces): late fee amount (billing_evt_late_fee), down payment formula (billing_evt_installment_schedule), "installment_fee ... to no other bill" (billing_evt_installment_schedule), representative fee clause (billing_evt_payment_application). All other base boundaries (grace counting, caps, tolerance, cure/reinstatement no-fee, payment order, accepted methods) are inherited.

[7] Seed. Customer Renee Gallardo (a0683675-...), VA, inception 2017-04-20; drivers Renee and Isabel (licensed 2026-09-24). Ledger history across three terms: term 2025-04-20 (installment 4, late fee 6.00 on 2025-07-30, notice 2025-08-05 with minimum 158.44, cure 2025-08-08), term 2025-10-20 (down payment 318.54, five installments 155.97/155.98, assisted payment 2025-11-25 with fee 1.75, bank EFT payment returned 2026-01-27 with NSF 25.00, repaid 2026-01-29 before any late fee), term 2026-04-20 (down payment 389.91, installments 151.38/151.37, assisted payment 2026-05-25 with fee 3.36, late fee 15.00 on 2026-06-30, partial 90.00 on 2026-09-24). Every historical amount was recomputed with the extended formulas as of its own date: renewal down payments 318.54 (29% of 1098.40) and 389.91 (34% of 1146.80); late fees 6.00 (12.00 x 0.50) and 15.00 (12.00 x 1.25); assisted fees 1.75 (3.50 x 0.50) and 3.36 (3.50 x 0.80 x 1.20); installment charges (task 1's installment-charge policy, VA state charge 6.00 prorated to premium/175, relief 0.50 for an electronic last payment with 36+ months tenure, else 0.75, plus 1.00 per return and 0.75/1.50 per late fee in 12 months) 3.82, 3.42, 3.42, 3.42, 4.42, 4.42, 4.35, 4.35, 5.10, 4.35, 4.34 - history teaches the charter, not a contrary algorithm. Ledger nets to the account balance 75.71. No notice is pending (account current; notice trigger day 10 = 2026-10-06), so no unsettled status lights an obligation no task carries. Cache: account_balance equals the ledger; no cache trap.

[8] Persona. Rushed office manager; volunteers only the goal, timing (today, on this call), channel (with the representative), method (her debit card) and scope (everything including the renewal down payment). Given only when asked: phone (locator), date of birth, ZIP, license last four, policy number, the daughter's licensing, the 90.00 partial payment. Passive reactions: agrees to postings, accepts the representative fee, declines the online alternative, authorizes exactly the amount told at hand-over, repeats the confirmation, closes. No ask of her own beyond the root; she never asks for a waiver.

[9] Standard solution. find_customers(8045550127) -> verify (phone, DOB) -> find_auto_policies -> find_billing_accounts -> find_billing_ledger -> find_auto_transactions -> find_drivers -> late fee 3.80 on installment 6 -> additional-premium bill 96.38 (source e73edcdb-..., due 2026-10-20) -> renewal installment 1 649.39 with policy fee 20.00 (term 2026-10-20) -> hand over; customer pays 847.37 incl. fee 2.09 by debit_card. Terminal balance 0.00.

[10] Verification code and runs. _verify_lib.py replays gold writes with the real tools and evaluates each policy's compute on the handling-time world (initial_state + earlier gold writes); _build_t0.py printed: late fee 3.80 (baseline 15.0), AP bill 96.38 (102.59), renewal 649.39 (377.86), payment 847.37 (716.12); root with prerequisite skipped: 843.57 / 750.88 / 178.41. Gates run --task 0: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.
Revision log: (d) once task 1 claimed the installment-charge policy, every seeded installment fee (formerly the flat 8.00) was recomputed with it, and the payments that settled them, the 2025-08-05 notice minimum and the opening balance (75.71) were re-derived; late fee 3.92 -> 3.80, payment 716.84 -> 713.05 at that revision; gates re-run green. (a) check_extended flagged the module helper _account as an undiscoverable tool -> inlined the account lookup in each tool -> re-run OK. (b) replay closure mismatch (vehicles and drivers unread) -> removed the two vehicle rows (no reference), added a find_drivers read (Isabel is the driver the deposit rests on), shifted the call steps to 8/10/12/14 -> REPLAY OK. (c) as_purpose_rate guarded against an absent additional-premium bill (DAYS on an empty date).

[11] Draft from visible context only. Reading the published rules: the assisted-payment rule says the payment waits on three states; the ledger shows installment 6 unpaid past grace with no late fee, an additional-premium receipt with no bill, and a renewal premium whose bill date is today with no invoice; each depended-on rule names its own write; the formulas give 3.80, 96.38 (due 2026-10-20), 649.39 (+20.00 policy fee) and 847.37 with fee 2.09. Same object, order-free prerequisites, same values as gold; no second reading found (the one-month window, the 12/24-month bands and the 5-day purpose span are stated in whole months / calendar days).


[12] Rework round 2 (policy-task audit 0.md / _difficulty.md).
T0-1 / F1: the renewal rule now defines the expiring full-term premium as the billed term's full-term premium as last rated (full_term_premium_after of the latest auto_additional_premium / auto_return_premium effective in that term, else the term premium entry), and compute reads it through XLATEST on auto_transactions (increase-base factor now cross-difficulty). The world was re-seeded so the rate shock is real: the renewal term premium written 2026-09-29 is 2148.70 (the 2026-09-20 offer quoted 1358.96 before Isabel was licensed), 118.5% of the endorsed 1812.60. Recomputed: renewal down payment 515.23 -> 649.39 (base 1980.65 x 29% = 574.39 + 75.00), assisted payment 713.05 -> 847.37 with fee 1.93 -> 2.09 (balance 845.28); skip runs 843.57 / 750.88 / 178.41; whole baselines 429.74 and 850.28.
T0-2: the opening line no longer names the renewal or its down payment ("pay off everything on my billing account today, with my debit card"), and the background line about the October renewal was removed; the renewal invoice is reachable only through the assisted-payment rule's second prerequisite sentence.
Charter observations closed in the same pass: O1 (no-fee-on-cure branch added to the assisted payment compute), O2/O3 (late-fee rule ties the fee to the installment whose grace days just ended and names its baseline 'standard'), O6 (tool returns say 'resulting balance'), O7 (KY tier values 9.50 / 2.50 / 4.50 no longer coincide with any plan's fee), O9 (raw parameter tokens replaced by business words). None changes a task-0 value except as listed.
user_scenario:
You are Renee Gallardo, 45, office manager at a family dental practice in Richmond, Virginia, calling Cardinal Mutual on the morning of Wednesday, September 30, 2026, between patients. You are organised and a little rushed. You want your billing account completely cleared today so that nothing is hanging over you. You open with something like: "Hi, I'd like to pay off everything on my billing account today, with my debit card, while I have you on the phone." You want it done on this call, with the representative, from your own debit card; you are not going to log in online or mail a check, and you want the whole balance on the account cleared, not just part of it. You do not know what the total is and you leave it to the representative to work out.

When asked how to find your account you give your phone number, 8045550127. To verify, you give your date of birth, 1981-06-09; if a second item is needed you also give your ZIP code, 23225, and only if still asked, the last four of your driver's license, 4182. Your email, if anyone asks, is renee.gallardo@outlook.com, and your policy number is CAP-VA-5530418.

Only when the representative asks whether anything changed on the policy lately do you mention that your daughter Isabel got her license last week and you had her added. Only when asked about September's bill do you say you paid $90 of it online on the 24th and meant to pay the rest later. You have no idea about fees or how anything is calculated, and you never offer figures of your own.

If the representative says some charges have to be put on the account before taking your payment, you say that is fine and to go ahead. If they mention a fee for paying with a representative, you accept it; if they suggest paying online instead to avoid it, you say you would rather just finish it with them now. When the representative tells you the total and hands the payment over to you, you authorize exactly that amount from your debit card and repeat the confirmation number you receive. Once you have the confirmation number and hear that the balance is paid, you thank them and end the call; you do not ask for anything else.

gold_actions.business_effect: Posts the late fee owed on installment 6 of the 2026-04-20 term, unpaid beyond tolerance when its three grace days (Sep 27-29) ended.

request_binding.action_semantics: A late fee is a state-due charge: the installment due 2026-09-26 still carries 65.71 unpaid and today is the first day after its last grace day, so the account owes the fee whatever the caller asked; it is the only fee charge the records make due today.

discriminator.business_meaning: late fee on an installment unpaid after its grace days

stage_provenance.fact: The late fee entry is created by this call; the unpaid installment it rests on pre-exists.

base_preconditions.condition: Installment fees and policy fees follow the installment schedule; the late fee is a separate charge on an installed invoice of the current term.
A late fee is charged only when the installment is still unpaid after late_fee_grace_days calendar days past its due date.
No returned payment touches installment 6; the January 2026 return was settled on 2026-01-29.
The account is current, not cancelled; no reinstatement applies to this charge.
The 90.00 paid on 2026-09-24 was applied to installment 6, leaving 65.71 of it unpaid.

gold_actions.business_effect: Bills at once the additional premium of the 2026-09-24 driver addition, received after the term's last installment was invoiced.

request_binding.action_semantics: Additional premium received when no installment of the term is left unbilled is owed as an immediate bill; the 94.59 received on 2026-09-29 has no bill yet.

stage_provenance.fact: The additional-premium bill entry is created by this call; the premium it bills was received on 2026-09-29.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: The count starts the day after the due_date of the installment invoice, so the fee can post on the first day after the last grace day and never on a grace day.
